test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The boss said to the secretary, “Don’t forget to order A3 size paper.”

options.text: The boss told the secretary that she didn’t forget to order A3 size paper
The boss told the secretary that she should not forget to order A3 size paper
The boss asked the secretary to order A3 size paper.
The boss instructed the secretary not to forget to order A3 size paper.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The boss instructed the secretary not to forget to order A3 size paper.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Don’t forget to order" becomes "instructed not to forget to order"**
 
 
• Direct command "Don’t forget" is converted to "instructed not to forget" to match indirect speech.
 
• The verb remains in the infinitive form "to order".
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Indirect speech does not use quotation marks.
 
• Reporting clause follows the indirect speech statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The boss instructed the secretary not to forget to order A3 size paper."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The boss told the secretary that she didn’t forget to order A3 size paper."

 
 
• Incorrect tense and meaning: The use of "didn’t forget" implies an action already completed, which changes the original request's future-oriented instruction.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The boss told the secretary that she should not forget to order A3 size paper."
 
 
• Acceptable but less precise: The use of "should not forget" implies advice rather than a direct instruction.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The boss asked the secretary to order A3 size paper."
 
 
• Incomplete conversion: This sentence misses the critical element of "not forgetting," thus altering the original command's full meaning.
